role: Proof-of-concept for distinguishing individual spatial structure from cross-species spatial alignment; not a recalibration or rerun of observed RGFCA.

known_context.reason: Existing S1 can reject spatially unstructured data when no species share their boundary. S4 concerns estimator spread, not an induced nonzero mean.

design.geometry: 64 equally weighted cells on a periodic ring; 40 exchangeable synthetic species
design.shape: Cyclic Gaussian bump with width 3 cells, centered across cells and normalized to population SD 1
design.generator: q=round(f*40) species share one uniformly random cyclic phase; remaining species have independent uniform phases. Add independent unit Gaussian cell noise, then center each species field across cells.

calibration_comparison.structured_independent_phases: Generate f=0 fields retaining per-species spatial shape but with independent species phases.
calibration_comparison.within_species_cell_scramble: Independently permute cells within each f=0 calibration field, preserving every species' realized marginal values and self variance while destroying its spatial shape.
calibration_comparison.threshold: Separate upper 95th percentile (method=higher) for total and cross under each calibration model, fixed before independent evaluation
calibration_comparison.no_shared_evaluation: f=0 with nonzero amplitude is a valid structured no-alignment world, not a spatially unstructured world.
calibration_comparison.dependence: The two calibration models use paired marginal values; total and cross are related diagnostics, not independent scientific discoveries.

outputs: rejection fractions with 95% Wilson Monte Carlo intervals
interpretation_limits: The ring has uniform support and is not the real Earth, observed photo geometry, categorical palette/JSD, or the balanced outer schedule.
Any rejection rate is conditional on this toy generator and fixed empirical calibration; Wilson intervals omit uncertainty in the calibration threshold.
Observed G1, species-disjoint commonness, environmental means/interactions, H6/H6b, and all frozen gates remain unchanged.
Do not infer an observed shared-species fraction, name a geographic zone, or replace the actual primary null from this simulation.
No favourable seed, width, amplitude, cell-count or threshold search is permitted.
